PLAY · LOOP AND CURVE CONTROL

Busy Bee Loop Practice

Start at the bee and fly in loops — up, around, and around again — until you reach the flowers.

Four beautiful loops!

Loops are how cursive begins. Your pencil is learning to dance.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game builds loop and curve control — one of the foundation strokes behind handwriting. Tracing a clear path with a finger or a stylus teaches speed, rhythm and control long before pencils arrive on paper, and the generous engine means an honest attempt is always celebrated. Watch for the moment the whole arm starts doing the work instead of the wrist — that is the real milestone.

The worksheet button prints the original artwork with its tracing guides, a title and the instruction — perfect for a kitchen-table session. The my-drawing button saves exactly what your child drew on screen. Short, happy sessions of two or three adventures beat one long push, every time.
